purpose: Misconception records added only where direct empirical evidence has been checked in the diagnostic-evidence pass.

misconceptions.statement: The pupil treats the equals sign mainly as a command to calculate or as a signal that the answer comes next, rather than as a statement that two expressions have the same value.
diagnostic_signals: Rejects or misreads equations with operations on both sides
Expects the answer to appear only to the right of the equals sign
Calculates all visible numbers instead of comparing the two sides
misconceptions.use_limit: The study supports the operational-versus-relational reasoning pattern. It does not validate any single MathBridge question as a diagnostic test or establish prevalence in a specific jurisdiction.
